response.changelog:
What's New in Pixel OS v2.1.9-b1 (iOS Style UI Beta):
• Fixed In-Display Fingerprint: Pressing the fingerprint sensor during setup and on the lock screen now lights up properly and registers your finger right away.
• Fixed Dual SIM: Both SIM cards now work together reliably for calls, SMS, and mobile data.
• Fixed Calls, SMS & OTPs: Sending text messages, receiving bank/login OTPs, and making HD voice calls (including on Jio 4G/5G) now work properly.
• Fixed Phone App Warning: Removed the "This device isn't supported" warning banner when opening the Phone app after a restart.
• Fixed PhonePe & Banking Apps: Stopped PhonePe and other UPI/banking apps from randomly closing or crashing when you open or switch back to them.
• Fixed Double-Tap to Lock: Double-tapping empty space on the Home Screen now locks the phone right away.
